summary: Jasper County, SC tower run by the state forestry commission; registered in 2011 as US 920 and since removed. A 2026 county bid notice names a tower site on Okeetee Fire Tower Road.

facts.status_note: The register says the tower has been removed, with no date; a 2026 county bid notice names the tower site, but no source says whether a tower stands there

February 2026 Jasper County bid notice to prepare, grade and rock a tower site at 1261 Okeetee Fire Tower Road; the notice does not say a tower stands there

corrections.why: FFLOS lists Ridgeland as a separate lookout (US 921, SC 7) with its own point, and the Forest Lookouts site lists both names separately; the alias may belong to another record. A person should check whether they are one structure before removing it.

sources.title: Prepare, Grade, and Rock Tower Site (RFP #2026-7)

notes_for_editor: No build year, height or site description is in the sources. The Forest Lookouts Ridgeland page (cited by the record) describes a 100-foot steel tower erected near Ridgeland in November 1931 and marks it removed; it may be the Ridgeland entry or this tower, and the story does not decide. The 2026 notice is an emergency-services site project and does not say a tower stands there. The alias removal is proposed in corrections for human review, not applied.
